violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Pulled pork in the stand up cooler is not labeled (prepped two days before). -Artichokes in the desert cooler in cambro not labeled. -Portioned pork and chislic not labeled in stand up cooler.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. -Stand up cooler has liquid on the floor and should be cleaned up.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insect electrocution or trapping device was installed in an inappropriate location. -Fly strips were positioned over the prep sink, desert station, and 3 sink area.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -Shelled Eggs stored above raw whole onions in the walk-in cooler.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment did not meet proper design and/or construction characteristics. -Walk-in cooler has water on the floor. Management is aware of the situation and has a tech called to service the cooler.
